title: Usage Insights: support playbook, Jira macros, and known issues for beta
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
Goal
Create a support-facing playbook for the Usage Insights beta (route+model breakdown, top cost drivers, exports) including:
- Triage steps + internal checks
- Known issues list w/ workarounds + escalation owners
- Jira macros for common tickets (customer-facing responses that set expectations and avoid overpromising)
- Escalation paths to Telemetry/Analytics, Console Backend, Billing, and Security

Scope (beta)
- Console: Usage > Cost / Usage Insights pages (breakdowns + top drivers + freshness banner)
- API: usage insights query endpoints + export CSV job
- Permissions: RBAC gating for cost views and exports

Non-goals
- Writing end-user help center article (tracked under docs), but include links and alignment notes
- On-call runbook ownership changes (this ticket documents what exists + where to page)

Primary audiences
- Support (L1/L2), Solutions Engineering, CSMs running QBRs
- Eng on-call receiving escalations (Telemetry, Console Backend)

Links
- PRD: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROD/In-console+Usage+Insights+PRD
- API contract: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/Usage+Insights+API+Contract
- ADR (route normalization + attribution): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/ADR-Route+Normalization+and+Attribution
- Data freshness/quality plan: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PLAT/Usage+Insights+Data+Freshness+and+Quality
- SLO/perf budget: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Usage+Insights+SLO+and+Performance+Budget
- Beta release notes draft: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROD/Console+2026-03+Usage+Insights+Beta

---
Support Playbook (Beta)

1) First checks (before debugging)
A. Confirm feature access
- Is the account allowlisted for the beta? (Admin > Feature Flags: usage_insights_beta)
- Is workspace setting “Hide cost” enabled? If yes, expected behavior is cost columns hidden + export blocked.
- Verify user role: must have permission to view cost and initiate exports (see ENG-3820).

B. Confirm time range expectations
- Data is aggregated; freshness lag can be up to ~60–180 minutes in beta depending on region and late events.
- For “Last 24h” / “Today” views: partial data is possible; look for freshness banner timestamp.

C. Confirm the question the customer is asking
Common cases:
- “Totals don’t match invoice” (reconciliation)
- “Missing a route / OpenAI-compat endpoint not showing” (route normalization / tagging)
- “Duplicate rows / model aliases” (bucketing)
- “Export problems” (permissions, throttling, file size)
- “Timeouts for 30-day range” (query perf + guidance)

2) Triage decision tree
A. Discrepancy vs billing (most sensitive)
- Determine the comparison target:
  - Billing invoice totals (authoritative) vs console Usage Insights totals
  - Note: invoice is based on billing hooks; insights is derived from telemetry + attribution rules.
- Gather:
  - Workspace ID, project/env, time range (UTC vs local), region/deployment mode filters
  - Route + model filters used
  - Screenshot of totals + the “Data as of” freshness timestamp
  - Whether retries/fallbacks are involved (customer mentions “spikes” or “unexpected model usage”)
- Internal checks:
  - Reconciliation job status (Billing Drift) and tolerance result for that workspace/time bucket
  - Late event rate for the selected period (events arriving >2h late)
  - Known rounding behavior in export vs UI (see Known Issues #1)
- If drift > tolerance or reproducible mismatch:
  - Escalate to Billing hooks owner (Cole Summers) + Cost attribution owner (Nadia Rahman)
  - Attach: raw totals, time range, route/model, and whether the mismatch is consistent across multiple periods.

B. Missing route breakdown (including OpenAI-compatible endpoints)
- Ask customer to provide one request ID or approximate timestamp + endpoint they called.
- Internal checks:
  - Verify route_tag present in metering/telemetry event for that region (streaming endpoints had a past gap; see Known Issues #3)
  - Validate route normalization mapping is templating path params (e.g., /v1/projects/{id}/…)
- Workarounds:
  - Advise switching filter to “Route (raw)” if exposed (beta-only toggle), or use model-only breakdown temporarily.
  - If the account is heavily using OpenAI-compat paths, confirm they are being normalized to canonical Redwood routes.
- Escalation:
  - Telemetry ingestion tagging: Thomas Baird / Logan Wright
  - Route normalization library: ENG-3813 owner (Thomas Baird) + Console Backend (Chloe Martin)

C. Duplicate rows / model alias confusion
- Symptoms:
  - Same model appears twice (e.g., “llama-3.1-70b” and “llama-3.1-70b-instruct” or an alias)
  - Export CSV shows duplicates while UI looks grouped
- Internal checks:
  - Confirm model_family + model_version bucketing fields populated
  - Check if the customer pinned aliases historically (older requests before bucketing migration)
- Workarounds:
  - Filter by model_family where possible
  - Use shorter time range that starts after the bucketing rollout date for cleaner grouping
- Escalation:
  - Model bucketing: ENG-3823 (Nadia Rahman + Logan Wright)

D. Timeouts / slow console
- Expectations:
  - For interactive console queries, p95 target is under a few seconds for <=7d ranges; 30d may be slow in beta depending on filters.
- Workarounds:
  - Recommend 7d range + export for longer periods
  - Reduce dimension cardinality: avoid “All projects” + “All routes” + “All models” + 30d
- Escalation:
  - Console perf: ENG-3821 (Felix Schneider) / query service owner (Logan Wright)

E. Export issues (CSV)
- If customer can’t export:
  - Verify RBAC permission + workspace “Hide cost”
  - Confirm export job limits (row cap / time range cap in beta)
- If export is slow:
  - Export is async; the UI should show “Preparing” state and then provide a signed URL.
- If customer asks for PDF/shareable QBR:
  - Beta supports CSV export + shareable link (if enabled); PDF is out of scope for initial release.
- Escalation:
  - Export pipeline: ENG-3816 (Chloe Martin) + Security audit logging questions to Kevin Osei

3) Standard request for info (copy/paste)
Use this checklist for any Usage Insights ticket:
- Workspace ID + project/env
- Time range + timezone
- Filters applied (route/model/region/deployment mode)
- Screenshot of the table + “Data as of” timestamp
- One example request ID (if applicable) OR approximate timestamp + endpoint
- Whether the customer is comparing against invoice totals (and invoice period)

4) Escalation paths (who to page / where to file)
- Billing mismatch / reconciliation drift:
  - Page: #eng-billing-hooks (Cole Summers)
  - CC: Nadia Rahman
  - Ticket type: “billing correctness”
- Missing route tags / ingestion gaps:
  - Page: #eng-platform-telemetry (Logan Wright / Thomas Baird)
  - Ticket type: “telemetry data quality”
- Console backend query errors / 5xx / auth:
  - Page: #console-backend-oncall (Chloe Martin)
  - Ticket type: “console service”
- RBAC / permission anomalies:
  - Page: #eng-security-authz (Kaitlyn Nguyen)
  - Ticket type: “authz”
- Export/audit logging questions (compliance-sensitive customers):
  - Page: #eng-security (Kevin Osei / Marcus Lin)
  - Ticket type: “security review / audit logs”

5) Known Issues (beta) — customer-safe wording + internal notes
#1: Minor rounding differences between UI and export
- Customer-facing: “You may see small differences due to rounding at different aggregation levels; totals should match within tolerance.”
- Internal: Reconciliation tolerance policy applies; export uses full precision internally but displays rounded currency columns.
- Status: Mitigation in progress via reconciliation tests (ENG-3817).

#2: Totals may lag for very recent usage (late events)
- Customer-facing: “Recent usage may take up to a couple hours to fully appear, especially for high-volume streaming workloads.”
- Internal: late event handling depends on region pipeline; check freshness dashboard.
- Status: Ongoing; improved freshness indicators in console (ENG-3824).

#3: Missing route breakdown for some streaming endpoints in one region (historical gap)
- Customer-facing: “Some requests may be grouped under ‘Unknown route’ during the beta while we finalize endpoint tagging.”
- Internal: route_tag missing for streaming ingest in a subset of traffic; see telemetry issue thread and backfill plan.
- Status: Fix rolling out with instrumentation (ENG-3822); backfill may be limited by retention.

#4: OpenAI-compatible endpoints may appear under normalized canonical routes
- Customer-facing: “We normalize endpoints so usage is grouped consistently (e.g., OpenAI-compatible paths map to a canonical route).”
- Internal: ensure mapping table includes all compat endpoints.
- Status: Partially addressed via route normalization ADR + library (ENG-3813).

#5: Long time ranges (30d) can time out for high-cardinality workspaces
- Customer-facing: “For large workspaces, try 7 days in-console and use export for longer ranges.”
- Internal: query optimization / indexes / materialized views ongoing.
- Status: Performance work in ENG-3821.

#6: Duplicate export rows for model aliases in some periods
- Customer-facing: “You may see duplicates when a model alias changed; filtering by model family helps.”
- Internal: bucketing migration edge case; see support ticket SUP-24844.
- Status: Fix in ENG-3823.

6) Jira macros (drafts)
Macro: “Usage Insights totals don’t match invoice”
- Title: Usage Insights totals vs invoice mismatch — request details
- Customer response:
  “Thanks for the details — Usage Insights is derived from telemetry and may lag slightly for recent usage. To investigate, could you share: workspace/project, time range (and timezone), filters applied, and a screenshot showing the ‘Data as of’ timestamp? If you’re comparing to an invoice, please include the invoice period as well. We’ll reconcile the totals and follow up.”
- Internal checklist:
  - Check reconciliation drift dashboard
  - Confirm late-event rate
  - Escalate to Billing hooks + Cost attribution if drift > tolerance

Macro: “Missing route breakdown / OpenAI compat route not visible”
- Customer response:
  “Usage Insights groups requests by normalized route. If you can share an example request ID (or a timestamp + endpoint), we can confirm how it’s being tagged and ensure it appears in the breakdown.”
- Internal checklist:
  - Validate route_tag present
  - Validate route normalization mapping

Macro: “Export permission denied”
- Customer response:
  “Exports are restricted to users with cost permissions. If you believe you should have access, please share your role and the workspace you’re viewing. An admin can also confirm whether cost visibility is disabled for the workspace.”
- Internal checklist:
  - Check RBAC + workspace hide-cost
  - Audit log event present for export attempt

Macro: “Usage Insights page times out”
- Customer response:
  “For large workspaces, longer time ranges can take longer to compute during the beta. If you try a shorter time range (e.g., 7 days) or narrower filters, it should load quickly. For longer periods, export is the best option. If you share your filters and time range, we can also investigate performance.”
- Internal checklist:
  - Grab query trace/request ID
  - Check query cache hit/miss + warehouse latency

7) Rollout notes for Support
- Beta enablement is allowlist-based. Support should not promise GA dates; refer to “beta availability expanding over March”.
- For compliance-sensitive customers (fintech/healthcare), double-check export audit logging expectations before enabling exports.
- For any billing discrepancy ticket: treat as high priority; do not suggest “billing is wrong” — position invoice as authoritative and focus on reconciliation.

Acceptance Criteria
- Playbook published in internal Support space and linked from:
  - Linear initiative PM-1427
  - Support Jira queue pinned message / macro library
- 4 Jira macros created/updated (mismatch, missing route, export permission, timeout)
- Known issues list reviewed by Product (Paula Mendes) + Cost attribution owner (Nadia Rahman)
- Escalation owners verified with on-call rotations/channels

Open Questions
- Do we want to expose “Unknown route” as a label in UI for beta, or collapse into “Other”? (Support prefers explicit “Unknown route” to reduce confusion.)
- Export limits for beta: row cap and max range (need final numbers from ENG-3816 implementation)

Risks
- If reconciliation drift alerts are noisy, Support will get flooded; ensure threshold aligns with tolerance policy.
- If route normalization changes mid-beta, customer reports may shift week-over-week; need explicit release note callout.
